rationale: The rule was selected using development-only image statistics and visual inspection.
A density threshold of 0.05 removes most blank regions while preserving faint handwriting better than the more aggressive 0.10 threshold.
The 0.02 and 0.05 rules were visually similar, while 0.05 provides stronger rejection of weak background evidence.
Foreground filtering is treated only as preprocessing and not as a methodological contribution.
